item.title: Restore large MongoDB backup in Docker Desktop
item.description:
Recently, I wanted to restore a MongoDB backup of a bigger production database locally for testing.

The container was created with a standard docker run command: docker run -d -p 27017:27017 -v {PATH_TO_FOLDER}:/data-test -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=admin -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin --name test-mongo mongo:4.4.3.

item.title: Fun with MongoDB: Referencing of Documents with Spring Data Mongo
item.description:
Recently I had a problem with mongoDB and Spring Data Mongo, which was mostly my own fault. That is what happens when you go into a project without a real clue about the technology. In Mongodb there are basically 2 ways to reference other documents, or to roughly translate it for people, who like myself, have a much bigger background in SQL: a Foreign key relationship.

  1. Manual Referencing
  2. DBRef
